column1: # Every code point where Python's full-case str.lower() and Go's
# simple-case strings.ToLower() disagree, with the post-strip form
# pinned beets 2.13.1 produces for each: lower, transliterate through
# Swept all 1112064 valid code points (surrogates excluded) against the
# venv at tools/venv/.venv; 56 diverge.  One of them, U+0130, is the
# full-versus-simple case mapping difference the sweep went looking for.
# The other 55 are a Unicode version skew: Go 1.27 carries Unicode
# TestStringDistCaseMappingSweep replays these through the Go pipeline
# and names the two rows, U+A7CB and U+A7DC, where the post-strip forms
